review.purpose: Meaning-first German dialogue adaptation against old wording at identical native synthesis settings
review.precision: ONNX CPU, complete FLOAT32 mono 44100 Hz WAV
review.reason: User approved the meaning-first approach used for SRT. Isolate revised wording on difficult source-linked phrases, without assuming a naturalness or timing pass.
review.input: Eight frozen English-linked phrases: Bill Ackman327.64..336.28s (four speaker-turn phrases), Mind Control265.9381875..289.7381875s (four contextual phrases). Old German and assistant-adapted German for each, same voice M1/M2 and seed within pair. Sixteen calls/sixteen checked internal chunks. Smoke first old-German phrase once, reused in workload. Existing English transcript not freshly audio-verified. No ASR, external translation or video upload.
review.outputs: dubbing_naturalness_2026-10-28/meaning_first_trial_2026-10-29/trial/smoke and /workload: sixteen unique native WAVs and reports with source IDs, hashes, durations, caption-span differences. Separate local result_review.html, no video encoding or mixing. Max30s perclip,180s newly generated perstage,32MiBaudio plus1MiBmetadata perstage. Originals unchanged.
review.quality_tradeoffs: Tests text adaptation only; original acting, acoustic pause matching, voice cloning and synchronized video are not implemented by this experiment. Same native1.0 may still sound too fast/slow or miss duration. Old wording preserves known defects as a control. No waveform stretching, clipping, padding or revisions/retries. One seed per wording does not establish a population-level result. Cache miss aborts without model download.
review.cost_estimate: Controller pinned-rate compute maximum: two180s stages at2CPU/4GiB approximately $0.01263; allowing cleanup and up to64MiB total audio transfer suggests about $0.02. Declared target $0.10, not a provider-enforced billing cap; current provider charges/overhead may differ. No GPU, paid retry, ASR or translation API cost.
